title: eml_parser: Algorithmic-complexity DoS (O(n^4) regex backtracking) in Received-header parsing (CVE-2026-129307)
description: A regular expression denial of service (ReDoS) vulnerability exists in eml-parser versions prior to 3.0.4 in the Received-header parsing function. The vulnerability arises from a dynamically constructed regex with multiple greedy capture groups followed by a normalized date literal that may not match the original header line, causing catastrophic backtracking with O(n^4) complexity. This leads to high CPU usage and can hang parser workers on crafted email headers. The issue is fixed in version 3.0.4.
